GIA LAI ELECTRICITY 
JOINT STOCK COMPANY 
No.: 118/2026/CV - GEC 
Re: Explanation of the  Income Statement 
for Quarter 1/2026 
            SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF VIETNAM 
Independence - Freedom - Happiness 
 
 
 
Gia Lai, April 29th, 2026 
 
 
 To :  - THE STATE SECURITIES COMMISSION 
- THE HO CHI MINH STOCK EXCHANGE 
 
Pursuant to the regulations on information disclosure according to Circular No. 96/2020/TT -
BTC dated November 16, 2020 , of the Ministry of Finance, Gia Lai Electricity Joint Stock 
Company (stock symbol: GEG) hereby provides the following explanation for the variance of 
over 10% in its profit after corporate income tax (CIT)  in the Income Statement for Quarter 
1/2026 compared to the same period last year: 
Unit: billion VND 
No Item Quarter 1/2026 Quarter 1/2025 Change Q1/2026-Q1/2025 
1 
Profit after CIT in 
Separate Financial 
Statements 
92.53  218.97  (126.44) 
2 
Profit after CIT in 
Consolidated Financial 
Statements 
263.65  612.95  (349.3) 
 
1. Profit after corporate income tax , according to the Separate Income Statement for Q1 2026, 
reached VND 92.53 billion, representing a decrease of VND 126.44 billion , or 58%, compared 
to the same period last year, of which: 
- Revenue from sales of electricity increased by VND 30.4 billion, 
- Financial expenses increased by more than VND 179 billion, due to the reversal of 
provisions for investments in subsidiaries and associates recorded in the prior year's 
corresponding period. 
2. Profit after corporate income tax , according to the Consolidated Income Statement for Q1 
2026, reached VND 263.65 billion, representing a decrease of VND 349.3 billion, or 5 7%, 
compared to the same period last year, due to the following reasons: 
- In Q1/2025, the company recorded additional revenue from Tan Phu Dong 1 Wind Power 
Plant, which was carried forward from the 2023-2024 period. 
- Interest expenses decreased by nearly VND 30 billion due to a reduction in outstanding debt 
compared to the same period last year.

Above is the explanation of Gia Lai Electricity Joint Stock Company on the variance in profit 
after CIT on the Income Statement for Q1 2026 compared to the same period last year. 
Respectfully submitted.

GENERAL DIRECTOR

Nguyen Thai Ha
